description: Retrieve one License catalog entry by its id, e.g. gplv3, seat, exception. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use license_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the License catalog, e.g. gplv3, seat, exception. Get the id list from license_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: license_get
